workflow_rationale: This task has distinct sequential phases: analysis (fetch + score), optimization (conversion suggestions), rewriting (critical pages), and documentation (compile final deliverables). The feature workflow respects these dependencies. Note: 15 intermediate deliverables already exist in deliverables/ from prior work sessions - the remaining work focuses on compiling these into the 4 final deliverable documents and filling any gaps.

critical_findings.missing_skill_file: .claude/skills/copywriter/SKILL.md does NOT exist in the codebase. The analysis methodology (4 C's rubric, AIDA/PAS/BAB/FAB frameworks) is defined inline in spec.md patterns section and must be applied directly by the coder agent.

agents_available.copywriter-hybrid: .claude/agents/copywriter-hybrid.md - Voice calibration, quality checks, content type ratios
agents_available.hormozi-conversion-optimizer: .claude/agents/hormozi-conversion-optimizer.md - Value equation, CTA variants, objection handling

phases.name: Review & Gap Analysis of Existing Deliverables
phases.description: Read all 15 existing intermediate deliverables to understand what analysis has already been completed and identify any gaps that need filling before compiling final documents.

subtasks.description: Read all raw content files (homepage, services, contact) and language variants comparison to verify complete page coverage

verification.instructions: Confirm all selfrules.org pages documented: homepage, /lavoriamo-insieme, /parliamo, /it, /en variants. Note any missing pages.

subtasks.notes: All 5 required page variants verified: homepage, /lavoriamo-insieme, /parliamo, /it, /en. No gaps found. 4 raw content files totaling 831 lines of documented content. Language comparison identifies 4 priority tone inconsistencies. Site uses single-page architecture (services and contact are homepage sections).

subtasks.description: Read all scoring and analysis files (4Cs scoring, AIDA/PAS/FAB analysis, critical pages identification) to verify completeness

verification.instructions: Verify: every page section has 4 C's scores (Clear, Concise, Compelling, Credible out of 10), AIDA framework applied to each page, 3 most critical pages identified with rationale

subtasks.notes: All 4 scoring/analysis files verified complete. 4 C's scores present for all 6 site sections (Hero 36/40, Journey 35/40, Services 32/40, Testimonials 34/40, CTA 38/40, Footer 30/40) plus 24 granular element scores. AIDA applied to 5 page variants (Homepage IT/EN, Services, Contact, Newsletter). PAS applied to 8 sections. FAB applied to 7 sections. 3 critical pages identified: Newsletter CTA (F grade), Contact Section (Attention crash), English Version (systematic -2.5pts). No gaps found.

subtasks.description: Read conversion optimization files (value equation, CTA variants, objection handling, lead magnets) to verify Hormozi methodology applied

verification.instructions: Verify: Value Equation applied, CTA variants at soft/medium/high intensity, 3+ variants per CTA location, objections mapped with responses

subtasks.description: Read all 3 critical page rewrites to verify voice calibration and quality checks applied per copywriter-hybrid methodology

verification.instructions: Verify: before/after comparisons present, voice calibration documented (Romei/Toon/Sinek ratios), Romei/Toon/Sinek quality checks applied

phases.name: Compile Copy Audit Report
phases.description: Compile the comprehensive scored copy audit report from existing intermediate deliverables (4Cs scores, AIDA/PAS/FAB analysis, critical pages identification) into the final selfrules-copy-audit.md following the output format from spec.md.

subtasks.description: Create deliverables/selfrules-copy-audit.md compiling all audit data: Executive Summary, Framework Analysis (AIDA/PAS scores in table format), 4 C's Scorecard (section x 4 C's matrix with totals), Critical Issues (current quote + recommended rewrite), 10x Opportunities, Priority Rewrites, Action Items checklist

verification.instructions: Verify document contains: Executive Summary (2-3 sentences), Framework Analysis tables, 4 C's Scorecard matrix, Critical Issues with quotes+rewrites, 10x Opportunities with specific fixes, Priority Rewrites before/after, Action Items checkboxes

subtasks.notes: This is the master audit document. Must include composite scores out of 40 per section, identify weakest C per section, cover ALL pages analyzed.

phases.name: Compile Critical Page Rewrites
phases.description: Compile the 3 critical page rewrites into a single formatted document with before/after comparisons, voice calibration documentation, and quality check results.

subtasks.description: Create deliverables/selfrules-critical-page-rewrites.md combining all 3 rewrites with: intro explaining why these 3 pages were selected, before/after for each page with voice calibration ratios documented, quality check results (Romei/Toon/Sinek checks), readability metrics per rewrite

verification.instructions: Verify: all 3 rewrites included, before/after comparisons present for each, voice calibration ratios documented, Romei/Toon/Sinek quality checks applied and documented per rewrite

phases.name: Create Tone of Voice Framework
phases.description: Create the Tone of Voice Framework document synthesizing voice principles from copywriter-hybrid agent, CLAUDE.md guidelines, and patterns observed in the audit analysis.

subtasks.description: Create deliverables/selfrules-tov-framework.md with: voice philosophy (Romei/Toon/Sinek blend), content type calibration table with ratios, quality checklists per voice element, do/don't examples, signature phrases, readability targets (Flesch 60-70, Grade 6-8), actionable templates for each content type, Italian/English consistency guidelines

verification.instructions: Verify: all content types covered with Romei/Toon/Sinek ratios, quality checklists present, do/don't examples are specific (not generic), readability targets specified, framework is immediately actionable

phases.name: Compile CTA Library
phases.description: Compile the optimized CTA Library from existing CTA variants, objection handling, and lead magnet files into a single organized reference document.

subtasks.description: Create deliverables/selfrules-cta-library.md with: CTA variants organized by page location and intensity level (soft/medium/high), minimum 3 variants per location (9+ total), objection handling responses for each CTA, lead magnet suggestions with placement recommendations, Value Equation application notes, A/B testing suggestions

verification.instructions: Verify: 9+ CTA variants total (3 per intensity level minimum), objection handling for common blockers (price, skepticism, time), lead magnets included, Value Equation principles applied

phases.name: Final Quality Review
phases.description: Review all 4 final deliverables against QA acceptance criteria from spec.md, verify scoring methodology consistency, and ensure all success criteria are met.

subtasks.description: Cross-review all 4 final deliverables against spec.md QA criteria: scoring consistency across pages, voice calibration documented in rewrites, CTA variants cover all intensity levels, TOV framework is actionable, before/after examples are specific, objection handling covers price/skepticism/time, Italian language preserved, no corporate jargon in rewrites

verification.instructions: All QA sign-off items from spec.md verified: all 4 deliverables complete, scoring methodology consistent, voice calibration documented, CTA variants cover soft/medium/high, TOV framework actionable, before/after specific, objection handling covers common blockers, Italian preserved, no corporate jargon

subtasks.notes: May need to update/fix any of the 4 deliverables if QA issues are found

parallel_groups.reason: All three depend only on phase-1-audit-review, produce separate files with no overlap

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Phases 3-5 could theoretically run in parallel but since all are document compilation by a single agent, sequential is more practical

summary.startup_command: No services needed - this is a documentation-only task. The coder agent reads existing deliverables and compiles final documents.
